lines.en: The Imperial Army has certainly wasted no time. We've got to escape to Centurion's Rest.
lines.zh: 帝国军的动作很快。我们得逃去百夫长安息处。

lines.en: And you think I will just willingly go with you?
lines.zh: 你以为我会自愿跟你走吗？

lines.en: You will. We both know that the snakes in the capital cannot be trusted. You're much safer here, away from their schemes.
lines.zh: 你会的。我们都知道，首都的那群毒蛇不值得信任。你在这里远离他们的阴谋诡计，会安全得多。

lines.en: Antares...  You are going to get yourself killed...  You don't deserve this.
lines.zh: 安塔瑞斯…… 你会害死你自己的…… 你不该有这样的下场。

lines.en: I have already given my life. But so too will my men if we do not escape immediately.  Please, we must go to Centurion's Rest.
lines.zh: 我心意已決。我们要是不立刻逃走，我的手下也都会死。 陛下，我们必须要去百夫长安息处。
